Samuel helped Eli every day: he opened the doors, swept the floor and looked after the lamps.

It happened three times! Then Eli understood: it was God calling the boy!

Samuel didn’t know God’s voice yet.

Samuel, now grown up, talks to the people under a tree. They listen carefully.
